schema.description: Jailbreak-wrapped variants of the harmful prompts, used to populate the harmful+complied (HC) cell for difference-in-means refusal-direction analysis. Each base harmful instruction is wrapped in a generic jailbreak template; the model's actual response and 'refused' label are recorded at extraction time.

fields.prompt: jailbreak-wrapped request text sent to the model
fields.expected_harmful: bool: is the underlying REQUEST harmful (always true)
fields.template: name of the jailbreak template applied
fields.base_id: id of the source harmful record in the source metadata.json
